newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's total debt level rises to $91.42 bln.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's total debt level rises to $91.42 bln.

text.p: Argentina's total debt rose to $91.42 billion in September from $87.09 billion at the end of last year, according to the Economy Ministry.
By the end of June this year, the total debt level stood at $90.20 billion, the ministry said in its October fiscal bulletin.

Argentina's total debt levels have come under increasing scrutiny in recent months considering this year's overshoot in the projected budget deficit. The larger deficit has meant Argentina has had to borrow more than anticipated in the international capital markets.
